item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Hosted Skill and Agent Bindings for Azure Functions
item.description:
Hosted Skill and Agent bindings for Azure Functions are in public preview. The bindings aim to reduce application plumbing and lifecycle code needed when adding agents, so developers can focus on business logic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Rename Server in Azure Database for MySQL
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports generally available server renaming. Existing server instances can be renamed without recreating the server, migrating data, or disrupting applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Enhanced Azure Site Recovery support for VMSS Flex
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports an enhanced disaster recovery experience for Virtual Machine Scale Sets with Flexible orchestration. The update improves target configuration and end-to-end recovery workflows, including failover and reprotection.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure SQL Managed Instance updates for late-September 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL Managed Instance received late-September 2026 updates, including a flexible memory feature that lets you change the memory allocated to an instance without changing the instance size.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door profile and route level WAF policies
item.description:
Azure Front Door Web Application Firewall (WAF) now supports associating WAF policies at the profile and route levels in public preview. This lets you apply baseline protection across a profile and more targeted policies on specific routes.

  • Source: Azure Updates
